title: LangGraph agent (Python)
summary: create_agent with HumanInTheLoopMiddleware for the approval gate, a checkpointer for resume, model and recursion limits, OpenTelemetry.
verified: RUN: the scaffold's tests and gold set ran here against the offline stub with langchain 1.5.2 and langgraph 1.2.24, including interrupt and resume; the image built and its gold set passed 11 of 11 inside the container with no network. Not run against a live model here.
stack_line: A LangGraph agent in Python (langchain 1.5, langgraph 1.2).
run_cmd: uv run -m agent.app "Where is my order ORD-1001?"
live: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and AGENT_MODE=live. For OpenAI set OPENAI_API_KEY and AGENT_MODEL=openai:<model id>; for Bedrock, AWS credentials and AGENT_MODEL=bedrock_converse:<model id>.

ai_act.purpose: Answers customers' questions about their orders and requests refunds; a person approves every refund before it is issued.
notice: You're chatting with an AI assistant, not a person.
